title: Associate Product Designer (Cinmar) – Color, Print & Pattern
note: Developmental home-goods design role for Grandin Road focused on color, print and pattern; home product design experience is expected.

facts.summary: Developmental associate role on the Grandin Road home design team that builds toward a Designer position, reporting to a Senior Designer.
facts.duties: Create trend boards, seasonal palettes and print/pattern direction; place artwork across home products; develop SKU designs through samples; prepare spec packages; present to merchandising and executives; some travel.
facts.requirements: Experience designing home products (decor, serveware/dinnerware, home textiles); strong color, print and pattern skills; trend interpretation; collaboration and presentation skills; no years of experience stated.
facts.apply: Apply through QVC Group's Workday careers posting.
